name: python-migrations
title: Python SQL migrations
blurb: Forward-only SQLite migrations with a checksum ledger: an applied file that changed is drift and blocks the run, a pending migration older than the newest applied one is refused, and each file runs in one real transaction because sqlite3 never wraps DDL in one
default_description: A forward-only SQL migration runner for SQLite, with a ledger that proves a file changed.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: drift-exits-1
verify.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); set +e; cp -r migrations "$d/m"; .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} up --db "$d/app.db" --dir "$d/m" >/dev/null; printf -- '-- edited\n' >> "$d/m/0001_create_notes.sql"; .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} up --db "$d/app.db" --dir "$d/m" >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; test "$s" -eq 1

detect.contains: which migration ran, when, and what it hashed to
